questions.question: If the altitude from two vertices of a triangle to the opposite sides are equal, then the triangle will be:
questions.questionHtml: If the altitude from two vertices of a triangle to the opposite sides are equal, then the triangle will be:
questions.solution:
Altitudes from two vertices to the opposite sides are equal. In an isosceles triangle, altitudes from equal sides are equal.

∴ Triangle is isosceles.

questions.question: A secant PAB is drawn from an external point P to the circle with the centre at O, intersecting it at A and B. If OP = 18 cm, PA = 12 cm and PB = 22.5 cm, then the radius of the circle is:
questions.questionHtml: A secant PAB is drawn from an external point P to the circle with the centre at O, intersecting it at A and B. If OP = 18 cm, PA = 12 cm and PB = 22.5 cm, then the radius of the circle is:
questions.solution:
OP = 18 cm, PA = 12 cm, PB = 22.5 cm

Let radius = x, PC = 18 - x, PD = 18 + x

⇒ PA × PB = PC × PD

⇒ 12 × 22.5 = (18 - x)(18 + x) ⇒ 270 = 289 - x2

⇒ x = √19 cm.

questions.question: An article costs ₹1,000 for a salesman. He fixes its marked price as ₹1,500. He sells it to a customer at a discount of 20%. He gives a further discount of 10% for each cash payment. Find the percentage of loss or gain that the salesman makes on sale.
questions.questionHtml: An article costs ₹1,000 for a salesman. He fixes its marked price as ₹1,500. He sells it to a customer at a discount of 20%. He gives a further discount of 10% for each cash payment. Find the percentage of loss or gain that the salesman makes on sale.
questions.solution:
SP after 20% discount: ₹1,500 - (0.20 × 1,500) = ₹1,200

SP after 10% cash discount: ₹1,200 - (0.10 × 1,200) = ₹1,080

Gain = ₹1,080 - ₹1,000 = ₹80 ⇒ Gain% = (80/1,000) × 100 = 8%.

questions.question: The monthly incomes of A, B and C are in the ratio 2 : 9 : 3 and their expenses are in the ratio 3 : 9 : 5. If A’s saving is half of his total income, then savings of A, B and C are, respectively, in the ratio of:
questions.questionHtml: The monthly incomes of A, B and C are in the ratio 2 : 9 : 3 and their expenses are in the ratio 3 : 9 : 5. If A’s saving is half of his total income, then savings of A, B and C are, respectively, in the ratio of:
questions.solution:
Let incomes of A, B, C be 2x, 9x, 3x and expenses be 3y, 9y, 5y respectively.

A's saving = 2x/2 = x

For A: x = 2x - 3y ⟹ y = x/3

For B: Savings = 9x - 9y = 9x - 3x = 6x

For C: Savings = 3x - 5y = 3x - 5(x/3) = (9x - 5x)/3 = 4x/3

Ratio = x : 6x : 4x/3 ⟹ 3 : 18 : 4

questions.question: A tank is filled in 45 minutes by two pipes, A and B. Pipe B fills the tank twice as fast as A. How much time (in minutes) will pipe A alone take to fill the tank?
questions.questionHtml: A tank is filled in 45 minutes by two pipes, A and B. Pipe B fills the tank twice as fast as A. How much time (in minutes) will pipe A alone take to fill the tank?
questions.solution:
Let the time taken by pipe A alone to fill the tank be x minutes

Rate of filling of pipe A = 1/x

Rate of filling of pipe B = 2/x

Combined rate = 1/x + 2/x = 3/x

Given combined rate = 1/45 ⇒ 3/x = 1/45

⇒ x = 3 × 45 ⇒ x = 135 minutes

questions.question: In a circular race of 1600 m in length, Bhaskar and Vinay start with speeds of 27 km/h and 45 km/h starting at the same time from the same point. When will they meet for the first time on the track when running in the opposite directions and the same direction, respectively?
questions.questionHtml: In a circular race of 1600 m in length, Bhaskar and Vinay start with speeds of 27 km/h and 45 km/h starting at the same time from the same point. When will they meet for the first time on the track when running in the opposite directions and the same direction, respectively?
questions.solution:
Speed of Bhaskar = 27 km/h = 7.5 m/s

Speed of Vinay = 45 km/h = 12.5 m/s

Opposite directions:

Relative speed = 7.5 + 12.5 = 20 m/s

Time = 1600 / 20 = 80 s = 1 min 20 s

Same direction:

Effective speed = 12.5 - 7.5 = 5 m/s

Time = 1600 / 5 = 320 s = 5 min 20 s

questions.question: The greatest value of sin 4 θ + cos 4 θ is:
questions.questionHtml: The greatest value of sin<sup>4</sup>θ + cos<sup>4</sup>θ is:
questions.solution:
sin4(θ) + cos4(θ) = (sin2(θ) + cos2(θ))2 - 2 sin2(θ) cos2(θ)

⇒ sin2(θ) + cos2(θ) = 1

⇒ sin2(θ) cos2(θ) = (1/2 sin(2θ))2 = 1/4 sin2(2θ)

⇒ sin4(θ) + cos4(θ) = 1 - 1/2 sin2(2θ)

Max value at θ = 0

⇒ sin4(θ) + cos4(θ) = 1 - 0 = 1

questions.question: The given table shows the expenditure of a company (in lakh rupees) per annum over the years. Year Salary Fuel and Transport Bonus Interest on Loan Taxes 2005 212 78 4.00 24.6 88 2006 225 98 4.25 29.7 110 2007 236 105 4.75 36.8 125 2008 247 125 5.55 42.3 103 2009 295 145 6.25 49.6 118 2010 325 155 6.85 58.4 135 The total expenditure on all these categories in 2006 is what percentage (rounded off to two places of decimals) of the total expenditure in 2009?
questions.questionHtml:
The given table shows the expenditure of a company (in lakh rupees) per annum over the years.
 
Year Salary Fuel and Transport Bonus Interest on Loan Taxes
2005 212 78 4.00 24.6 88
2006 225 98 4.25 29.7 110
2007 236 105 4.75 36.8 125
2008 247 125 5.55 42.3 103
2009 295 145 6.25 49.6 118
2010 325 155 6.85 58.4 135

The total expenditure on all these categories in 2006 is what percentage (rounded off to two places of decimals) of the total expenditure in 2009?
questions.solution:
Total Expenditure in 2006 = 225 + 98 + 4.25 + 29.7 + 110 = 466.95

Total Expenditure in 2009 = 295 + 145 + 6.25 + 49.6 + 118 = 613.85

Total expenditure in 2006 of the total expenditure in 2009 = (466.95 / 613.85) × 100 = 76.06%

questions.question: \(\text{Simplify } \frac{4x^2 - 49y^2}{2x + 7y} + 7y - 2x\)
questions.questionHtml: \(\text{Simplify } \frac{4x^2 - 49y^2}{2x + 7y} + 7y - 2x\)
questions.solution:
Factor the numerator: 4x2 - 49y2 = (2x - 7y)(2x + 7y)

Expression becomes: ((2x - 7y)(2x + 7y))/(2x + 7y) + 7y - 2x

Cancel common factor: (2x - 7y) + 7y - 2x

Simplify: 2x - 7y + 7y - 2x = 0

questions.question: In a triangle PQR, ∠P + ∠Q = 84°. Find the value of ∠R.
questions.questionHtml: In a triangle PQR, ∠P + ∠Q = 84°. Find the value of ∠R.
questions.solution:
Sum of angles in a triangle = 180º

⇒ 180º = 84º + ∠R ⇒ ∠R = 180º - 84º ⇒ ∠R = 96º.

questions.question: Find the volume of a cone having base radius 3.5 cm and height 18 cm.
questions.questionHtml: Find the volume of a cone having base radius 3.5 cm and height 18 cm.
questions.solution:
V = (1/3)πr²h ⇒ V = (1/3)π(3.5)²(18)

V = 231 cm3

questions.question: The following pie-chart shows the distribution of students at graduate level in different institutes in a town. Study the given chart and answer the question that follows. Distribution of students at graduate level institutes If the total number of students at the graduate level is 2,46,000, then how many students of institutes A and B are studying at graduate level?
questions.questionHtml:
The following pie-chart shows the distribution of students at graduate level in different institutes in a town. Study the given chart and answer the question that follows.
Distribution of students at graduate level institutes

If the total number of students at the graduate level is 2,46,000, then how many students of institutes A and B are studying
at graduate level?
questions.solution:
Total number of students at the graduate level = 2,46,000

Number of students in institute A = (17/100) × 2,46,000 = 41,820

Number of students in institute B = (14/100) × 2,46,000 = 34,440

Total number of students in institutes A and B = 41,820 + 34,440 = 76,260.

questions.question: Ram's income is 2.5% more than Shyam's income. By what percentage is Shyam's income less than Ram's income?
questions.questionHtml: Ram's income is 2.5% more than Shyam's income. By what percentage is Shyam's income less than Ram's income?
questions.solution:
Let Shyam's income be 100 units

Ram's income = 100 + 2.5 = 102.5 units

Difference = 2.5 units ⇒ Percentage decrease = (2.5/102.5) × 100

Percentage decrease = 2.439%

questions.question: If \(\frac{x}{x^2 - 2x + 1} = \frac{1}{3}\) then the value of \(x^3 + \frac{1}{x^3}\) is:
questions.questionHtml: If \(\frac{x}{x^2 - 2x + 1} = \frac{1}{3}\) then the value of \(x^3 + \frac{1}{x^3}\) is:
questions.solution:
⇒ (x)/(x2 - 2x + 1) = (1)/(3)

⇒ (x)/(x(x - 2 + (1)/(x))) = (1)/(3)

⇒ (1)/((x - 2 + (1)/(x))) = (1)/(3)

⇒ x - 2 + (1)/(x) = 3

⇒ x3 + (1)/(x3) = 53 - 3(5) = 110

questions.question: If x = a sec θ cos ϕ, y = b sec θ sin ϕ and z = c tan θ, then the value of \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} - \frac{z^2}{c^2}\) is equal to:
questions.questionHtml: If x = a sec θ cos ϕ, y = b sec θ sin ϕ and z = c tan θ, then the value of \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} - \frac{z^2}{c^2}\) is equal to:
questions.solution:
x = a secθ cosφ, y = b secθ sinφ, z = c tanθ

Calculate (x2/a2 + y2/b2 - z2/c2):

⇒ (a2 sec2θ cos2φ)/a2 + (b2 sec2θ sin2φ)/b2 - (c2 tan2θ)/c2, sec2θ cos2φ + sec2θ sin2φ - tan2θ

⇒ sec2θ (cos2φ + sin2φ) - tan2θ

⇒ sec2θ - tan2θ = 1.

questions.question: In how much time will ₹5,000 at 4% per annum simple interest produce the same interest as ₹8,000 in \(2\frac{1}{2}\) years at 8% per annum simple interest?
questions.questionHtml: In how much time will ₹5,000 at 4% per annum simple interest produce the same interest as ₹8,000 in \(2\frac{1}{2}\) years at 8% per annum simple interest?
questions.solution:
SI = (P × r × t)/100

Interest from ₹8,000 = (8000 × 8 × 5)/(2 × 100) = ₹1,600

Principal (P1) = ₹5,000, Rate (r1) = 4%

SI = (5000 × 4 × t1)/100, 200 × t1 = 1600 

t1 = 1600/200 = 8 years

questions.question: A shopkeeper has a fault of 100 g in a 3 kg weight. He sold 3 kg of potatoes to Charu using the same faulty weight for ₹46. The cost price of the potatoes for the seller was ₹12 per kg. How much profit (in ₹) did he earn on the potatoes?
questions.questionHtml: A shopkeeper has a fault of 100 g in a 3 kg weight. He sold 3 kg of potatoes to Charu using the same faulty weight for ₹46. The cost price of the potatoes for the seller was ₹12 per kg. How much profit (in ₹) did he earn on the potatoes?
questions.solution:
Actual weight sold = 3 kg - 100 g = 2.9 kg

Selling price of 2.9 kg potatoes = ₹46

Cost price of 2.9 kg potatoes = 2.9 × 12 = ₹34.8

Profit = ₹46 - ₹34.8 = ₹11.2

questions.question: In triangle XYZ, A is a point on YZ such that XA = YA. If ∠XYA = 50° and ∠AXZ = 19° , what is the degree measure of ∠XZA?
questions.questionHtml: In triangle XYZ, A is a point on YZ such that XA = YA. If ∠XYA = 50° and ∠AXZ  = 19° , what is the degree measure of ∠XZA?
questions.solution:
⇒ XA = YA, ∠XYA = 50º, ∠AXZ = 19º

In ∆XYA: ∠XAY = 180º - 2 × 50º = 80º

In ∆XAZ: ∠XAY = ∠AXZ + ∠XZA

⇒ 80º = 19º + ∠XZA

⇒ ∠XZA = 80º - 19º = 61º

questions.question: Find the value of the unknowns: x + 1.5y + 2z = 5.5 x + 5y + 7z = 15 3x + 11y + 13z = 25
questions.questionHtml:
Find the value of the unknowns:
x + 1.5y + 2z = 5.5
x + 5y + 7z = 15
3x + 11y + 13z = 25
questions.solution:
x + 1.5y + 2z = 5.5, x + 5y + 7z = 15, 3x + 11y + 13z = 25

From x + 1.5y + 2z = 5.5, x = 5.5 - 1.5y - 2z

Substitute x in x + 5y + 7z = 15

⇒ (5.5 - 1.5y - 2z) + 5y + 7z = 15

⇒ 3.5y + 5z = 9.5 ⇒ y = (9.5 - 5z) / 3.5

Substitute x in 3x + 11y + 13z = 25 ⇒  3(5.5 - 1.5y - 2z) + 11y + 13z = 25

⇒ 6.5y + 7z = 8.5 ⇒ y = (8.5 - 7z) / 6.5

Equate y equations: (9.5 - 5z) / 3.5 = (8.5 - 7z) / 6.5 ⇒ 6.5(9.5 - 5z) = 3.5(8.5 - 7z) ⇒ 32 - 8z = 0 ⇒ z = 4

Substitute z in y equation, y = (9.5 - 20) / 3.5 ⇒ y = -3

Substitute y and z in x equation, x = 5.5 + 4.5 - 8 ⇒ x = 2

The correct answer is: x = 2, y = -3, z = 4

questions.question: The following table shows the production (in units) and sales, of different items of a steel company. Study the table and answer the question that follows. Item Production (Units) Sales (Units) Plate 252 190 Bowl 356 307 Spoon 185 133 Pipe 220 155 Holder 458 419 In which item is there the least number of unsold items?
questions.questionHtml:
The following table shows the production (in units) and sales, of different items of a steel company. Study the table and answer the question that follows.
Item Production (Units) Sales (Units)
Plate 252 190
Bowl 356 307
Spoon 185 133
Pipe 220 155
Holder 458 419
In which item is there the least number of unsold items?
questions.solution:
Unsold items = Production - Sales

Plate: 252 - 190 = 62, Bowl: 356 - 307 = 49

Spoon: 185 - 133 = 52, Pipe: 220 - 155 = 65

Holder: 458 - 419 = 39, Least: Holder (39)

questions.question: 7 15 + 7 16 + 7 17 is divisible by which of the following given numbers?
questions.questionHtml: 715 + 716 + 717 is divisible by which of the following given numbers?
questions.solution:
715 + 716 + 717 = 715(1 + 7 + 72)

⇒ 1 + 7 + 49 = 57

⇒ 715 × 57 = 715 × 3 × 19

The expression is divisible by 3, 7, 19

questions.question: If cotθ = √11 , then the value of \(\frac{cosec^{2}θ - sec^{2}θ}{cosec^2θ + sec^2θ}\) is:
questions.questionHtml: If cotθ = √11 , then the value of \(\frac{cosec^{2}θ - sec^{2}θ}{cosec^2θ + sec^2θ}\) is:
questions.solution:
cotθ = √11

⇒ cose2θ = 1 + cot2θ = 1 + 11 = 12

⇒ sec2θ = 1 + tan2θ = 1 + (1/√11)2 = 1 + 1/11 = 12/11

⇒ (cosec2θ - sec2θ)/(cosec2θ + sec2θ) = (12 - 12/11) / (12 + 12/11)

⇒ (132/11 - 12/11) / (132/11 + 12/11) = 120/144 = 5/6
